models.caveat: Post-hoc reanalysis of already-viewed Qwen3 artifacts. The full historical run used pair-grouped splits and first-error-or-matched-all-correct boundaries. This sensitivity subsets the same 290 discovery pair IDs and applies the new shared canonical source-component folds/matched estimator, but it is not prospective confirmation and is not pooled with paired-first-error arms.

Existing OLMoE archives contain behavior/router/endpoint intervention artifacts but no recapture data_manifest.jsonl plus activation tensors. Interface-access values are therefore NA rather than imputed.

contrast_feature_control.reason: Existing recapture manifests contain no predeclared topic, token-class, language, or formatting contrast label. No proxy label is invented.

protocol.grouping_limitation: The shared folds join all 290 frozen discovery pairs to pre-existing canonical source_problem_id values from the versioned Qwen3 CPU-correction artifact. The mapping has complete unambiguous coverage and preserves component IDs defined over the full historical 580-pair universe. The upstream grouping is a registered post-hoc sensitivity artifact, not a new prospective freeze.
